home.title: Hood Warfare 2 Guide: Price, Weapons, Maps, Modes & Tips
home.description: Unofficial Hood Warfare 2 guide: Steam price and download, all weapons and killstreaks, 5 maps, 6 modes, beginner tips, patch notes and live player count.
home.lede: The Chicago gang-war shooter from Trapstar Games, out on Steam since October 8, 2026. Everything you need to buy it, learn it and win: weapons, killstreaks, maps, modes, patch notes and live player numbers, checked against the Steam store and the developer's own notes.
home.streaks_note: Four killstreaks, earned with 3, 5, 7 and 9 kills in a row.
what: Hood Warfare 2 is a budget-priced multiplayer first-person shooter for Windows PC. Two rival gangs fight over the streets of Chicago across six modes and five maps. It is built in Unreal Engine 5 and is the sequel to 2023's Hood Warfare, which was set in Detroit.

If you have played Call of Duty, you will feel at home: create-a-class loadouts with attachments, perks and equipment, a Modern Warfare-style HUD and killstreaks. The game leans into dark, crude humour. The Snitch killstreak works like a UAV, and the Drive By streak sends a car full of homies blasting music down the block.

It went viral in its first weekend after Rainbow Six Siege pro Merc posted a clip of its killstreaks, from the Snitch UAV to the music-blasting Drive By, that had passed five million views by October 12. Concurrent players climbed from a few thousand in the first days to more than 15,000 on October 13.

faq.q: Is Hood Warfare 2 on PS5, Xbox or mobile?
faq.a: No. As of {today} it is only sold on Steam for Windows PC. Console and mobile "versions" you see advertised are not from Trapstar Games.

faq.q: When did Hood Warfare 2 come out?
faq.a: October 8, 2026, nearly four years after the first Hood Warfare.
Trapstar Games, a small independent studio that develops and publishes the game itself.

faq.q: Can I play Hood Warfare 2 solo?
faq.a: Yes. There is no story campaign, but you can play any mode against bots and, since patch 1.0.1.4, create password-protected private matches with friends.

faq.q: How many people play Hood Warfare 2?
faq.a: The latest Steam count is on our Hood Warfare 2 player count and Steam charts page. The highest figure reported so far is {peak} concurrent players in the first week.
Yes. Steam lists full controller support, although players report that aim assist is very weak, so mouse and keyboard is more forgiving.

faq.q: What languages does Hood Warfare 2 support?
faq.a: English only. Menus, voice lines and subtitles are in English, and Steam lists no other language. There is no official translation.

faq.q: Is Hood Warfare 2 just a Call of Duty clone?
faq.a: It borrows heavily from Call of Duty: create-a-class, killstreaks and modes that mirror Domination, Kill Confirmed and Search and Destroy. Reviewers like the gunplay and humour for the price; the most common complaints are spawn deaths and a small amount of content.

home.vs_title: Hood Warfare vs Hood Warfare 2: which one is the viral game?
home.vs_intro: Two games share the name. The one that went viral in October 2026 is Hood Warfare 2. The first Hood Warfare game is a smaller 2023 Early Access release from the same studio, and searches for "Hood Warfare" without the 2 often land on it.
home.vs_note: This site covers Hood Warfare 2. Make sure the Steam page you open is app 5155360 before you buy.

home.glossary_intro: "Hood" is American slang for a neighbourhood, so the title means roughly "neighbourhood warfare". The game is in English only; this table pairs the in-game names with their meaning.

download.title: Hood Warfare 2 Download & Price on Steam (System Requirements)
download.description: How to download Hood Warfare 2 safely on Steam: current price in your currency, step-by-step purchase, PC system requirements, disk space and refund rules.
download.lede: Hood Warfare 2 costs {price} on Steam, and Steam is the only place to buy it. This page shows today's price in your currency, how to buy and install it, and whether your PC can run it.
download.price_note: Fetched from the Steam store; your final price depends on the region of your Steam account.
steps: Install the Steam client from store.steampowered.com and sign in or create an account.
Open the Hood Warfare 2 store page or search for "Hood Warfare 2" in Steam.
Select Add to Cart, then pay with any payment method Steam supports in your region.
Install from your Library. Allow at least 25 GB of free space; an SSD is recommended.
Launch the game. It runs with Easy Anti-Cheat; if Windows asks for permission, allow it or online play won't work.
Check the version number in the bottom-right corner of the main menu. If it is older than {version}, fully exit Steam (Steam menu, then Exit) and reopen it to force the update.
safety: There is no official free download, APK, PS5, Xbox or mobile version. Sites offering "Hood Warfare 2 free download" or a cracked copy are unofficial and often bundle malware.
Unofficial copies don't receive patches, and online play runs through Steam with Easy Anti-Cheat and a kernel-level anti-cheat.

Not confirmed. Kernel-level anti-cheat often blocks Proton.

regional: Steam charges in your account's currency. The price table above refreshes from Steam every 3 hours, so it already includes any current discount.
The game is in English only: menus, voice lines and subtitles.
Steam's standard refund policy applies: request a refund within 14 days of purchase with less than 2 hours played.

faq.q: How big is the Hood Warfare 2 download?
faq.a: Steam asks for 25 GB of free space at minimum and 30 GB recommended.

faq.q: Can my PC run Hood Warfare 2?
faq.a: You need at least a 6-core CPU such as a Ryzen 5 3600 or Core i5-9600K, 8 GB of RAM and a GTX 1660-class graphics card with DirectX 12. For high settings, aim for an RTX 3060 Ti or RTX 4060 and 16 GB of RAM.

faq.q: Why does the game say I'm on the wrong version?
faq.a: Steam sometimes holds updates until it restarts. Exit Steam completely from its top-left menu, reopen it and let the update finish.

weapons.title: Hood Warfare 2 Weapons, Killstreaks & Best Loadouts (All Unlock Levels)
weapons.description: Every Hood Warfare 2 gun with unlock level: Choppa, Uzi, AKM, .308 Sniper, Pump Shotty, Oldhead, Mac-10. Plus attachments, passives, killstreaks and starter loadouts.
weapons.h1: Hood Warfare 2 weapons, killstreaks and loadouts
weapons.lede: Hood Warfare 2 has seven primary guns, a sidearm, a blade and lethal equipment, all unlocked by levelling up. Trapstar Games hasn't published damage or fire-rate stats, so the advice below comes from play, not spreadsheets.
weapons.primary_title: Hood Warfare 2 primary weapons and unlock levels
weapons.unlock_note: Unlock levels were read from the in-game loadout menu during launch week and may change in later patches.
attach: Every gun has its own weapon challenges; completing them unlocks attachments for that gun. The Steam store names sights, magazines, grips and suppressors, plus other attachments.

Attachments players have seen so far include the reflex sight, holo sight, mini red dot, vertical grip, suppressor and flashlight. Some need unusual challenges: the no-stock option, for example, asks for kills without aiming down sights.
Pick each attachment to fix one problem: a sight you can see through, recoil you can't hold, running dry mid-fight, or showing up on the minimap. Test new parts on a map you know.
weapons.loadouts_title: Best Hood Warfare 2 loadouts for beginners
weapons.loadouts_note: These are our suggestions for the launch version, not official builds.

loadouts.name: All-rounder
loadouts.kit: Choppa or AKM, mini red dot, vertical grip, suppressor once unlocked. Glock. Grenade. Ammo passive.
loadouts.why: Works on every map and in every mode. Ammo matters because you can't easily pick up enemy guns.

loadouts.name: Close quarters
loadouts.kit: Uzi (level 5) or Mac-10 (level 28), reflex sight, extended magazine when unlocked. Glock. Grenade. Speed passive.
loadouts.why: For Chicago Mall and Supermarket, where fights start at a few metres and time-to-kill is short.

loadouts.name: Long lanes
loadouts.kit: .308 Sniper (level 10) or Oldhead (level 20). Glock as backup. Claymore to cover your flank. HP passive.
loadouts.why: For the long streets of Downtown and holding objectives from range in Turf War and Destroy The Block.

skins: Kills with a gun unlock that gun's skins. This track is separate from attachments, so a new camo doesn't mean you've finished the weapon challenges.
Gold finishes appear in the official screenshots; players report they take a long kill grind on each weapon.

maps.title: Hood Warfare 2 Maps: All 5 Chicago Maps & Tips
maps.description: All Hood Warfare 2 maps explained: Downtown, Suburbs, The Trenches, Chicago Mall and Supermarket, with engagement ranges, best loadouts and mode tips.
maps.lede: Hood Warfare 2 has five maps at launch, all set in and around Chicago. Four are named on the Steam store page; Supermarket was confirmed by the developer in patch 1.0.10. Every map is used for all six modes.
maps.spawn_title: Hood Warfare 2 map tips: spawns and drive-bys
spawn: Patch 1.0.10 reworked spawn points and added spawn protection after launch-week complaints about dying instantly. The developer warned that very small maps such as Supermarket will still have a short time-to-kill.
The same patch moved the Drive By killstreak's route on some maps, so old clips may show a different path.
maps.routes_title: Learn three routes on every map
maps.routes: For each map and mode, know an approach route to the objective, a pressure route for when that one is watched, and an exit route for leaving after you score. Bot matches let you walk them without being shot.
maps.unconfirmed: Some players mention a small map that resembles Call of Duty's Nuketown. Its name hasn't been confirmed by the developer, so it isn't listed here yet.

modes.title: Hood Warfare 2 Game Modes: All 6 Modes Explained
modes.description: Hood Warfare 2 modes explained: Turf War, GangBang, Chaos, Hit A Lick, Destroy The Block and Chain Snatch, with rules, Call of Duty equivalents and tips.
modes.lede: Hood Warfare 2 has six modes, renamed versions of Call of Duty classics. Only GangBang and Chaos are won by kills alone; in the other four a kill just opens the door to the objective.
private: Patch 1.0.1.4 added private matches: create a password-only lobby and share the password with your friends.
You can also play any mode on any map against bots. Bot matches may not give the same XP and challenge progress as online games; check the post-match screen before grinding them.

guide.title: Hood Warfare 2 Beginner Guide: Tips, Controls, Progression & Fixes
guide.description: New to Hood Warfare 2? A first-hour plan, how levels, weapon challenges and skins unlock, controls, voice chat, settings and fixes for no audio and update problems.
guide.lede: New to Hood Warfare 2? Here's what to do in your first hour, how unlocks work, and the settings and fixes that save the most frustration.
guide.first_hour_title: Your first hour in Hood Warfare 2

first_hour.step: Play GangBang or Chaos with the starting Choppa.
first_hour.why: Respawn modes give the most practice and XP. Don't swap guns after every death; you need time with one weapon to learn its recoil and push its challenges.

first_hour.step: Play an objective mode such as Turf War with the same gun.
first_hour.why: You'll see how fights flow around flags and learn the main routes on a map.

first_hour.step: Run a bot match on the map that gave you the most trouble.
first_hour.why: Walk the approach, pressure and exit routes without being punished for it.

first_hour.step: Open your loadout and check the three progression tracks.
first_hour.why: By now you'll have unlocked the Uzi at level 5 and new attachments. Set up a second class for close quarters.

progression.v: Match XP raises your level, which unlocks new guns and equipment. Players report most guns unlock within the first hour or two.
Each gun has its own challenges that unlock its attachments.
Kills with a gun unlock its camos, up to gold. Skin progress is tracked separately from attachments.

controls: Voice chat: push-to-talk is on <kbd>T</kbd> by default. Switch to open mic, or to team-only chat, in Settings.
Third-person view: use it to peek corners without exposing yourself, and switch back to first person for precise aim.
Movement: there is tactical sprint, jump and lean. Players report there is no slide-cancel and no fall damage.
Controller: aim assist is weak, so give yourself time to tune sensitivity, or try mouse and keyboard.
Report a cheater from the pause menu. The developer says players with many reports are reviewed and banned.
tips: Take the Ammo passive early. You run dry quickly and can't easily grab enemy guns.
Line up your killstreaks: Snitch at 3 kills shows the whole enemy team on the minimap, so use it before you push for the 5, 7 and 9 streaks.
Spawn protection now covers you briefly after respawning. Use that moment to move, not to stand still.
In Chain Snatch, plan where the enemy falls so you or a teammate can grab the chain. A kill without the pickup scores nothing.
In Destroy The Block you have one life per round. Don't test new loadouts there.

fixes.v: Open Settings and choose your audio output device manually (fixed in patch 1.0.1.4).
False kicks were fixed in 1.0.1.4. Update the game; if it continues, verify files in Steam (Properties, Installed Files, Verify integrity).
Make sure you're on the latest version shown in the bottom-right of the menu. Fully exit Steam and reopen it to force the update.
Fixed in 1.0.10 along with progression not showing after matches and wrong ping values.

method: "Playing now" is the number of people in the game at the moment of the reading, as reported by Steam. A reading every 3 hours can miss short spikes, so our tracked peaks will be lower than SteamDB's minute-by-minute peaks.
Hood Warfare 2 peaks in the US evening. US daytime readings can be a fifth or less of the evening peak: 2,611 on the morning of October 14 against 15,058 the night before.

weapons.choppa: AK-style starter rifle. Reliable at every range; level it first.
weapons.uzi: SMG for close fights on Chicago Mall and Supermarket.
weapons.akm: Second assault rifle; a step up from the Choppa for mid-range lanes.
weapons.sniper308: Sniper rifle. Players single out the game's sniping as a highlight; strong on Downtown.
weapons.pump: Pump shotgun for corners, stairwells and holding the bag room in Hit A Lick.
weapons.oldhead: Marksman rifle between the AKM and the sniper, good for holding flags from range.
weapons.mac10: Last gun to unlock. An SMG built for aggressive close-range play.
weapons.glock: Starting sidearm. Swap to it when your primary runs dry.
weapons.nine: A second pistol mentioned by one guide; not yet confirmed.
weapons.blade: Melee knife for quiet close-range kills.
weapons.grenade: Starting lethal. Clears flags and corners.
weapons.claymore: Proximity mine. Covers a flank or the bomb site.

passives.hp: Extra health. Part of the starting loadout.
passives.speed: Faster movement, similar to a stim. Good with SMGs.
passives.ammo: Carry more ammo. Recommended early because you can't easily pick up enemy guns.

snitch.effect: Shows all enemies on your team's minimap, like a UAV.
snitch.counter: Keep moving and avoid predictable routes while it's active.

homies.effect: Calls in a squad of three AI homies with Glocks. Each has one life.
homies.counter: They die quickly; take them before they flank.

bomber.effect: A homie with C4 who sprints at the enemy and detonates.
bomber.counter: Shoot it before it reaches you and don't bunch up.

driveby.effect: A car full of homies drives the block shooting out of the windows for about 45 seconds.
driveby.counter: Get indoors. The car can be shot and destroyed.

downtown.desc: City streets lined with dense building fronts, with fights at every range.
downtown.tips: Hold sightlines from cover with a rifle and avoid crossing open streets alone.

suburbs.desc: Residential blocks of houses and alleys. Mostly mid-range fights.
suburbs.tips: Clear houses room by room and watch the yards; third-person view helps check over fences.

trenches.desc: Narrow, trench-like lanes that funnel both teams into close and mid-range pushes.
trenches.tips: Push together. A grenade or claymore at a lane entrance stops a whole team.

mall.desc: An indoor shopping mall of corridors and storefronts that favours close quarters.
mall.tips: Hug storefronts and pre-aim corridor corners; the Speed passive pays off here.

supermarket.desc: One of the smallest maps: supermarket aisles where time-to-kill is very short, as the developer notes in patch 1.0.10.
supermarket.tips: Pre-aim aisle ends and expect to trade kills; it's the fastest map for weapon challenges.

turf_war.rules: Teams score points for holding territory.
turf_war.tips: Judge every fight by whether it takes, holds or retakes territory. Two flags held beats three contested.

gangbang.rules: Team deathmatch: the gang with the most kills wins.
gangbang.tips: Stick near teammates and trade kills. The best mode for weapon challenges.

chaos.rules: Free-for-all with no teams; the player with the most kills wins.
chaos.tips: Stay at the edges of fights and pick off whoever wins them.

hit_a_lick.rules: Steal the enemy's bag and bring it back to your base while defending your own.
hit_a_lick.tips: Escort the bag carrier: check corners ahead, take first contact and cover pursuers.

destroy_the_block.rules: One gang plants a bomb, the other defends or defuses it. One life per round.
destroy_the_block.tips: Information and survival beat early kills. Use Snitch before the push.

chain_snatch.rules: Kills drop chains. Collect enemy chains to score and grab your teammates' chains to deny points.
chain_snatch.tips: A kill counts only when the chain is picked up; fight where you can collect.

1846651706672850.title: Patch 1.0.1.4: private matches, anti-cheat kick fix, audio fix
points: Private matches: create a password-only lobby for your friends.
Fixed the anti-cheat wrongly kicking players.
Fixed no audio: choose an output device in Settings.
Fixed several join problems and crashes. Check that the menu shows version 1.0.1.4; exit Steam fully if the update doesn't download.

1846018067941553.title: Patch 1.0.10: anti-cheat, voice chat, spawn changes
points: Voice chat for the whole lobby or your team only; push-to-talk on T by default, open mic optional.
Anti-cheat added, plus a Report option in the pause menu.
Spawns reworked and spawn protection added. Small maps like Supermarket will still have a short time-to-kill.
10+ fixes: loadout presets not saving, progression missing after matches, player selection not saving, wrong ping. Drive-by routes adjusted on some maps.
